faq.q: How does Trackeys handle multi-tier distribution?
faq.a: Fully. Plant → regional DC → sub-distributor → retail is modeled as a first-class network. Each tier has its own visibility, pricing, credit and reporting — with roll-up all the way back to the brand owner.

An ensemble: classical time-series (SARIMA, Prophet), gradient boosting (LightGBM) on rich feature sets, and neural approaches for long-horizon and promotional lift. The system picks the best model per SKU per distributor based on cross-validation.

faq.q: Can distributors use their own mobile apps?
faq.a: Yes. Distributors use the white-labeled Trackeys distributor app or web portal. Orders, stock checks, payments and performance reports are all self-service.

faq.q: Does it handle expiry, batch and lot tracking?
faq.a: Yes — full FEFO/FIFO logic at warehouse and distributor level. Expiry alerts fire ahead of time so product can be rotated, discounted or returned before write-off.
